concept: Fargate: serverless containers without managing servers
tests: Choosing compute for containers that scale to zero without managing instances.
expected: AWS Fargate — serverless container execution (ECS/EKS), task count scales down to zero. Triggers: "containers", "scale to zero when idle", "without managing servers".
why_not: ECS on EC2 and self-managed Kubernetes require managing servers; a fixed ASG doesn't scale to zero.
